description: Stage 2 is the exact change-contract corpus. It removes most historical battle-test artifacts because the approved stage-one review bundle should already lock the diagnosis. It keeps direct architecture-control surfaces attached at higher authority: control-plane docs and templates, framework contracts, runtime/review/release schemas, the current official swarm runbooks, runtime scripts, and the tests that currently encode role/state/gate/release semantics. Supporting scientific-definition surfaces, example templates, mode examples, and worked-instance evidence remain available, but they are demoted to reference context so stage 2 can preserve empirical/modeling/hybrid generality without letting supporting examples outrank the direct framework control surfaces. Ad-hoc local operator workflow notes are intentionally excluded so stage 2 designs the supervision layer from the official framework surfaces and the approved stage-one diagnosis rather than from interim operator workarounds.
